definitions.explanation: exercising power or authority in an arbitrary, unreasonable, or oppressive manner

examples.japanese: {横暴|おうぼう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Tyrannical behavior will not be tolerated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横暴|おうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられなく→耐える：12087_taeru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I could no longer endure my boss's tyranny.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横暴|おうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}して→許す：02325_yurusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We must not allow the tyranny of those in power.

examples.japanese: {横暴|おうぼう}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われている→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧。
examples.english: He is disliked by those around him for his high-handed behavior.

notes:
{横暴|おうぼう} describes the abuse of power or authority, characterized by unreasonable, arbitrary, or oppressive behavior.

WRITING:
- {横|おう} (sideways; unreasonable, arbitrary)
- {暴|ぼう} (violence, tyranny)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Used as noun: {横暴|おうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to act tyrannically)
- Used as na-adjective: {横暴|おうぼう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (tyrannical attitude)
- {横暴|おうぼう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (tyrannical person)
- {横暴|おうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ (to not tolerate tyranny)
- {横暴|おうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧ (to behave tyrannically)

USAGE:
- Workplace: describing abusive bosses or management
- Politics: criticizing authoritarian actions
- Personal relationships: describing controlling behavior
- Historical: describing despots or tyrants

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{専横|せんおう}→専横：08003_senou⟧ (despotism, arrogance)
- {暴君|ぼうくん} (tyrant)
- ⟦{独裁|どくさい}→独裁：05969_dokusai⟧ (dictatorship)
- ⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧ (high-handed, overbearing)
